cohort: 52,671 term, nonanomalous singletons in breech presentation born in Canada (excluding Quebec) between 2003 and 2011
finding: Among term, nonanomalous singletons in breech presentation, composite neonatal mortality and morbidity rates were significantly higher after vaginal delivery and cesarean delivery in labor compared with cesarean delivery without labor.
mod_finding: Neonatal mortality and morbidity rates were significantly higher after vaginal delivery and cesarean delivery in labor compared with cesarean delivery without labor.
gest_age: Term gestation (37 weeks or greater, 40 weeks or greater)
